task.goal: Delete all but one of any recipes in the Broccoli app that are exact duplicates, ensuring at least one instance of each unique recipe remains
task.final_summary: The only exact duplicates were two identical "Eggplant Parmesan" recipes, and I deleted one of them, so one copy remains. The other five recipes (Baked Cod with Lemon and Dill, BBQ Chicken Quesadillas, Raspberry Almond Smoothie, Shrimp Avocado Salad, Spicy Tuna Wraps) each had only one instance, so nothing else was touched. The recipe list now holds six recipes.

steps.note: Launch Broccoli and read recipe list
Read the recipe list screen and open the first Eggplant Parmesan
Read recipe card titles to locate the two Eggplant Parmesan entries
Open first Eggplant Parmesan card and read its details
Back to list, open second Eggplant Parmesan card
Read second Eggplant Parmesan details to compare
Open More options menu to delete this duplicate
Tap Delete and confirm the confirmation dialog
Confirm DELETE and verify list has one Eggplant Parmesan
Recount recipe list titles to confirm 6 unique recipes
